in_sanskrit.name: शुरत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has won over, conquered or triumphed.

in_marathi.name: Surath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Surath is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means Sun. The word 'Rath' means chariot. Surath is thus the name of the Sun God who rides his chariot across the sky.
